name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Authless)
description: Enables the deployment of remote Model Context Protocol servers on Cloudflare Workers without requiring authentication. It allows users to integrate custom tools into AI clients like Claude Desktop or the Cloudflare AI Playground via Server-Sent Events.
